description: Cancels in two steps. The first mode takes reservation_number and phone_last4, emails a code and returns cancel_id. The second mode takes cancel_id and code, cancels the reservation, releases the room and notifies staff and guest. Automated cancellation is available more than 48 hours before check-in during office hours; other cancellations are handled by the property by phone. Cancellation codes have a separate budget of three per reservation in a rolling 24 hours and, by default, five across the portfolio in a rolling 24 hours, unaffected by booking traffic. The portfolio ceiling is configurable. Unavailable or over-budget cancellations give the property phone without a booking link. The published cancellation policy applies. No payment or refund is processed.

cancel_id.description: Opaque identifier returned by the first step.

code.description: The six-digit code received by the guest by email.

phone_last4.description: Last four digits of the booking contact phone number.

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a reservation
